```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r}
source("R/00_config.R")
library(ggplot2)
monthly <- readRDS(PROC_FILE)
```

```{r}
monthly$sets$gw %>% glimpse
```

## Predictor correlations

Spearman correlations among the 30 `ext` predictors from December 1926 through December 2015. The blocks are why the importance plots shuffle valuation ratios, yields, and technical signals together. Definitions are in the README.

```{r build-corr, include=FALSE}
source("R/14_corr_plot.R")
```

```{r corr, fig.width=8.5, fig.height=8}
g_corr
```

## Target over time

Log equity premium over the next 1, 3, and 12 months, with the historical mean. The shaded band is the 2016-2025 test window.

```{r build-plots, include=FALSE}
source("R/12_performance_plots.R")
```

```{r target, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
g_target
```

## Cumulative performance

Compounded return of each ext-set model against the historical-mean strategy. The dotted line is always T-bills.

```{r performance, fig.width=10, fig.height=8.5}
g_perf
```

## Theoretical best

The strategy that knows the sign of the realised log equity premium, against the historical mean.

```{r performance-best, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
g_perf_best
```

## Final performance

Test-set results for the ext-set models, the historical mean, and the theoretical best. Wealth starts at $1 million. `final_wealth_m` is terminal wealth in millions. The return, volatility, and drawdown columns are in percent.

```{r perf-table}
knitr::kable(perf_tbl, digits = 3)
```
